led_count.evidence: Three red LEDs are clearly visible in a vertical line on the breadboard.

resistor_count.evidence: Three blue-bodied resistors are visible, each connected in series with one of the three LEDs.

led_polarity.evidence: The orientation of the LED legs (anode/cathode) is obscured by the breadboard and the angle of the photo.

photoresistor.evidence: A small photoresistor with a serpentine pattern is visible in the lower section of the breadboard (rows 55-58).

photo_pin.evidence: A green wire connects the row containing one leg of the photoresistor to the A0 analog pin on the Arduino.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The green wire from the GND pin on the Arduino connects to the negative power rail on the breadboard.
